Urgent delivery

24/7 urgent delivery

Custom transport anywhere in Quebec, as fast as you need it — weekends and holidays included.

Get a quote 514-424-7936

The service in detail

A spare part holding up a production line, a document that must be delivered before closing time, an order your customer is waiting for today: Groupe Gama’s urgent delivery takes over when the deadline is not negotiable. We pick up and deliver the same day across Greater Montreal, and anywhere in Quebec depending on distance.

What’s included

  • Pickup within the hour in Greater Montreal, on call
  • Evening, overnight, weekend and holiday service
  • Parcels, boxes, pallets and bulky items
  • One driver from pickup to drop-off, no transfers
  • Delivery confirmation by phone or email

How it works

  1. Call or fill out the request

    Tell us what you are shipping, from where and to where. We confirm the price and pickup time right away.

  2. We pick up

    A Gama driver arrives at the address with a vehicle sized for the load.

  3. Direct delivery

    Your shipment goes straight to the recipient. You are notified as soon as it is delivered.

FAQ

FAQ — 24/7 urgent delivery

Do you really deliver on weekends and holidays?

Yes. The urgent service runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and statutory holidays. A surcharge may apply outside business hours; it is quoted before pickup.

How fast is same-day delivery?

In Greater Montreal, pickup usually happens within an hour of your call and delivery within the following hours, depending on distance and traffic. For the rest of Quebec, we confirm a time window when you book.

What can you transport urgently?

Anything from documents and parcels to pallets and bulky items. Give us the dimensions and weight and we send the right vehicle.

How is the price calculated?

Based on distance, volume and time of service. The price is confirmed before pickup — no surprises on arrival.
